description: Synthetic independent reference cases. Never add expected answers to a collection prompt. Score model proposals separately from validator/storage decisions; preserve source IDs and exact quote evidence. This is not a real RP transcript.

messages.name: Mara
messages.mes: In the station café, Mara asked Ellis to tell her before changing their travel plans, instead of deciding for both of them.

messages.name: Ellis
messages.mes: Ellis looked down at his cooling tea. After a long silence, he said, "I will ask you before booking anything. You can still choose to stay."

messages.name: Mara
messages.mes: Mara answered, "Yes. Asking first and keeping my choice are two different things." She unclenched her hand.

messages.name: Ellis
messages.mes: He nodded and put his notebook away. They kept tomorrow's train undecided by mutual agreement.

messages.name: Mara
messages.mes: At the same café table, Mara took out a borrowed brass key and asked whether Ellis had returned it to Ivo.

messages.name: Ellis
messages.mes: Ellis admitted he had forgotten. He handed the key to Ivo at the counter and said, "It's yours again."

messages.name: Mara
messages.mes: Ivo clipped the key onto his belt and thanked Ellis. Mara heard the tiny metallic click.

messages.name: Ellis
messages.mes: Ellis then asked whether Mara would move away next winter. She looked at the rain on the window and had not answered.

closure.quote: They kept tomorrow's train undecided by mutual agreement.
Ivo clipped the key onto his belt and thanked Ellis.

facts.mustPreserve: Ellis undertook to ask Mara before booking.
Mara retains the option to stay, independently of prior notice.
No train booked or final travel decision.
Silence/cooling tea and release of Mara's hand convey the response without invented forgiveness.
Ellis returned the key to Ivo, who clipped it to his belt.

messages.name: Nia
messages.mes: Nia asked Jo to ring the little bell three times before entering her studio.

messages.name: Jo
messages.mes: Jo agreed: "Three times, not three bells. And I will wait until you say yes."

messages.name: Nia
messages.mes: Nia said, "Yes to that. I may still say no." She drew her sleeve back from his hand.

messages.name: Jo
messages.mes: Jo let go immediately. "I'm sorry I grabbed your wrist without asking," he said, his voice barely audible.

messages.name: Nia
messages.mes: She nodded and said, "Thank you for letting go. Keep the promise." She did not say she forgave him.

messages.name: Jo
messages.mes: Privately Jo remembered the blue cupboard's code, 621. Nia did not hear or see this thought.

messages.name: Nia
messages.mes: Nia asked Jo whether he had told the gardener about the cupboard. Jo had not yet answered.

facts.mustPreserve: Bell rung three times, not three separate bells.
Wait for permission; Nia can refuse independently.
Jo released Nia's wrist and apologized specifically for grabbing without asking; she thanked him but did not forgive explicitly.
The sleeve withdrawal, release, and barely audible voice matter; no unsupported inner feeling.
Only Jo's private thought establishes his knowledge of 621; do not infer Nia or the gardener knows.
